paragraphs: R. Chanina bar Yosef, son of Rabbah. I have not found Rabbah to have a son named Yosef; it was Rava who had a son Rav Yosef. Nor have I found R. Chanina bar Yosef bar Rava. Only HaDar, Eruvin 65b, near the end, has Chanina bar Yosef, without mentioning bar Rabbah; he, R. Chiyya bar Abba, and R. Assi asked R. Yochanan, and R. Chiyya called R. Chanina bar Yosef an elder. If this R. Chanina bar Yosef were descended from Rabbah or Rava, how could he have been an elder in R. Yochanan's days? Perhaps HaDar has a scribal error and should read R. Chiyya bar Yosef, who was R. Yochanan's student (see there), or R. Chanina bar Yosef, his brother. In Yuchasin the words “son of Rabbah” are a scribal error. See R. Chama bar Yosef.
